test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "custom" **best fits in the context, **referring to a traditional practice or a usual way of doing things in Europe at that time.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word** "motive" **refers to a reason for doing something, which doesn't fit the context here.
 
• The word **"conventions"** refers to widely accepted ways or standards, which is close but not as precise as "custom".
 
• **"Ritualistic" **refers to the characteristic of rituals, which implies more ceremonial actions rather than just traditional practices.
